# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_1DTE

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** wiring_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE of the VWAP_CONTINUATION setup from 0DTE to 1DTE (weekly options) may reduce theta decay and improve the edge on the J anchor days, similar to the promising results seen in WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE for the vwap_continuation signal.

## Mechanism

Use the same vwap_continuation signal (trigger, entry, exit logic) but instead of 0DTE options, use the nearest weekly expiration (1DTE to 7DTE, but we'll start with 1DTE as a test). The exit remains the same: -50% premium stop (catastrophe cap) and TP1 at +50% with 2/3 qty sold, then runner to breakeven. We will test with the same strike selection (ATM or 1st OTM) but for weekly options.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (assuming similar premium levels as 0DTE ITM-2).
2. **Sample bias:** We are proposing a new candidate; no sample yet. High overfit risk if we tune to J days without OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will run walk-forward after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will check top 3 J days after Stage-1 and OOS)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if the weekly options have wider spreads or different liquidity, the edge could disappear or reverse. Max drawdown could exceed 50% if the setup fails catastrophically. Blow-up scenario: if the weekly options gap against the position and the catastrophe cap (-50%) is hit due to slippage.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if the edge comes from a few days, we will disclose).

## Pre-merge gate

Stage-1 backtest must pass: edge_capture > 0 (we need to see if it captures any of the J winners), then OOS with WF >= 0.70, then real-fills validation on top 3 J days (diff < ±20% from BS sim).

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- This is a structural change (DTE) that has shown promise in another candidate (WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE) but we have no data for VWAP_CONTINUATION specifically. The VWAP_CONTINUATION setup is currently disarmed (extra_setup_exec_armed.vwap_continuation=false) so we are proposing to test it with a DTE override.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This candidate complements [WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE] (which tested the same DTE idea on vwap_continuation signal but in isolation) and [VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE] (which is a wiring proposal for 2DTE that failed some gates). We are testing 1DTE as a middle ground. It does not conflict with any existing candidate but may supersede [VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE] if 1DTE performs better.
